name: ashby
longDescription: Ask your chats to search candidates, prep an interview and move pipeline tasks along.

beforeYouConnect: An Ashby Org Admin has to switch on the MCP Server toggle under Admin → Organization Setup → Opt-In Features before anyone can connect.
Your own Ashby account needs Elevated Access permissions to sign in.

actions.label: Search Ashby records
actions.description: Finds candidates, jobs and other Ashby records by name.

actions.label: Read an Ashby candidate
actions.description: Reads one candidate in full, with their applications and notes.

actions.label: List upcoming Ashby interviews
actions.description: Lists the interviews scheduled next, with who is attending.

actions.label: Read an Ashby job pipeline
actions.description: Reads where every candidate sits in one job's hiring stages.

actions.label: Add a note to a candidate
actions.description: Writes a note onto one Ashby candidate.
